episodes.synopsis: Ai-chan is back, with a special treat to wash away those Monday-morning blues!
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: How would your high school life have been different, if you had a girl with amazing proportions who loved you?
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: Senpai and his junior take a trip down south, but run into overstuffed trouble at the airport!
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: What better way to spend time with your girlfriend than when she's got a sexy swimsuit? But what if that means other men get to look at her too?
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Take a trip to the farm with Tawawa on Monday, as Ai-chan goes to experience the joy of country living.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: Sensei's life is about to change forever as he pops the question to his well-endowed former student.
episodes.title: Episode 6

episodes.synopsis: A new couple has moved into the apartment complex, and when the wife's bra falls off the clothesline and onto the veranda, it's time to get know them better!
episodes.title: Episode 7

episodes.synopsis: Senpai's junior has a secret hobby, and cameras have caught her in the act!
episodes.title: Episode 8

episodes.synopsis: It's off to the hot springs, where open-air baths and vibrating massage chairs await! And of course, the ping-pong balls aren't the only thing that bounce!
episodes.title: Episode 9

episodes.synopsis: After unfortunately getting him into the papers, the cheerleader has a special way of making it up to her boyfriend.
episodes.title: Episode 10

episodes.synopsis: Ai's in big trouble when her bra breaks, and she has to go shopping for a new, bigger one.
episodes.title: Episode 11

episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the big wedding, and there are plenty of other big things on display, too!
episodes.title: Episode 12
